      "text": "Based on the **Discord Paid Services Terms** (updated August 2025), here are the most critical points to note before purchasing a subscription (like Nitro or Server Boosts):\n\n### 1. The \"No Refund\" Policy is Strict\n*   **General Rule:** Payments are generally **non-refundable**. If you forget to cancel and get charged for a new month or year, they are under no obligation to refund you.\n*   **EU/UK Users:** The terms state that by purchasing, you consent to **immediate access** to the service. By doing so, you acknowledge that you **lose your standard 14-day right of withdrawal** (cooling-off period). Once you buy it, the sale is considered final.\n\n### 2. Auto-Renewal is \"On\" by Default\n*   **Recurring Charges:** When you buy a subscription (even if it\u0027s just a 1-month plan), you are authorizing **automatic recurring payments**.\n*   **Price Changes:** Discord can change subscription prices. If they do, the new price takes effect at the start of your *next* billing cycle. If you don\u0027t cancel before then, you are deemed to have accepted the new price.\n\n### 3. Account Bans \u003d Total Loss\n*   **No Refunds on Bans:** If your account is suspended or terminated for violating Discord\u0027s Terms of Service (e.g., harassment, safety violations), you **lose access** to all paid features immediately and are **not entitled to a refund** for the remaining time you already paid for.\n*   **Mobile Store Warning:** If you subscribed via Apple (iOS) or Google Play (Android) and your Discord account gets banned, **Discord cannot cancel the billing for you.** You must manually go into your phone\u0027s subscription settings to stop Apple/Google from charging you.\n\n### 4. Cancellation Does Not Mean \"Money Back\"\n*   **Effect of Cancellation:** You can cancel at any time, but the cancellation only stops the *next* payment. You will continue to have access to the perks until the current billing period ends. You do not get a pro-rated refund for the days you didn\u0027t use.\n\n### 5. Gifted \"Trials\" Can Trap You\n*   If you redeem a \"gifted\" subscription trial, you may be required to enter a payment method to activate it.\n*   **The Trap:** Once the trial period ends, it will **automatically convert into a paid subscription** at full price unless you cancel it beforehand.\n\n### 6. You Don\u0027t \"Own\" Virtual Goods\n*   Any profile decorations, avatar effects, or \"Discord Orbs\" you purchase are licensed to you, not sold.\n*   This means they have **no cash value**, cannot be traded or sold to others, and can be removed by Discord at any time if they discontinue the feature or ban your account.\n\n### Summary Checklist Before Buying:\n*   [ ] **Check the billing cycle:** Did you accidentally select \"Yearly\" instead of \"Monthly\"? (A common mistake).\n*   [ ] **Set a reminder:** If you only want it for one month, set a calendar reminder to cancel immediately after purchasing (you will keep the perks for the full 30 days).\n*   [ ] **Review Payment Method:** Ensure you are okay with this card being stored for auto-billing.",

If you are planning to spend money on a subscription, you need to be very careful.\n\nHere is the reality of how Discord handles raids and \"counter-raids,\" and why your account (and money) is at serious risk.\n\n### 1. Discord Does Not Recognize \"Counter-Raiding\"\nIn Discord\u0027s eyes, **there is no such thing as a \"good\" raid.**\n*   **The Policy:** Discord\u0027s Community Guidelines strictly prohibit \"coordinating server joins for the purposes of harassing server members.\"\n*   **The Reality:** If you and a group of people join a server to \"counter-raid\" (spamming, arguing, flooding channels), you are technically breaking the exact same rules as the original raiders. Discord often bans **both sides** because they see two groups violating the Terms of Service (ToS).\n\n### 2. \"Just Observing\" Can Get You Banned\nYou mentioned you are \"useless\" and just observing, but that might not save you.\n*   **Guilt by Association:** When Discord Trust \u0026 Safety creates a ban wave for a server involved in raiding (or a server being used to organize raids), they often ban **everyone** present in that server to ensure they catch all the bad actors.\n*   **The \"Nuke\":** It is common for users to wake up to a disabled account simply because they were lurking in a server that got flagged for organized harassment. Even if you didn\u0027t type a single message, your presence there makes you a potential target.\n\n### 3. The Financial Risk\nIf you buy a yearly Nitro subscription for ~$100 and get banned the next day for this counter-raid:\n*   **You lose the $100.** Discord will not refund you.\n*   **You lose the account.** You lose all your friends, server history, and badges.\n*   **Appeals are slow.** If you try to appeal saying \"I was just watching,\" it can take weeks or months to get a response, and they often deny these appeals if you were in a known raiding hub.\n\n### The Smart Move\nIf you value your account and the money you are about to spend:\n1.  **Leave the raid/counter-raid server immediately.** Do not just \"lurk.\"\n2.  **Do not participate** in any \"vigilante\" Discord justice. Report the bad server to Discord properly (via their support form) and let them handle it.\n3.  **Wait to buy.** Do not purchase a subscription until you are completely disassociated from any groups that break the Terms of Service.",

        "text": ". \"Just Observing\" Can Get You Banned\nYou mentioned you are \"useless\" and just observing, but that"

        "text": " might not save you.\n*   **Guilt by Association:** When Discord Trust \u0026 Safety creates a ban wave for"
